claims: As of April 2026, Justin Bieber is headlining the Coachella Music Festival in Indio, CA, on April 10-12 and April 17-19, 2026.
Justin Bieber has confirmed performances at the Empire Polo Field in Indio, California, for both weekends of Coachella (April 10-12 and April 17-19, 2026).
Justin Bieber's Justice world tour was cancelled in 2023 following health issues (Ramsay Hunt syndrome).
Justin Bieber's tour history includes the Purpose World Tour.
Justin Bieber's tour history includes the Believe Tour.
Justin Bieber's tour history includes the My World Tour.
Tickets for the 2026 Coachella performances are available through resale platforms like Viagogo and SeatGeek.
